CLOUD FIXER seat for roster group R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (new work, no PR yet). Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-arch-docs-first, then write the PR body (headings per .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-arch-docs-first <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-arch-docs-first. That second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Group R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST (wave 1, owner priority ASAP: tvofi 2026-10-22). Its brief and carries are on main's roster dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json; the latest carries are on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (read with jq). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 for every prepr/gate run (CI owns closures).
THE DESIGN IS APPROVED. Build exactly the approved design note: `git fetch origin design/r10-arch-docs-first && git show f122a1cb5d6aea08bb57840721e646c87f3c51fd:dev/programme/designs/R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST.md` (revision 2). Approval: `git fetch origin handoff-body/design-verdict-r10-arch-docs-first-r2 && git show FETCH_HEAD:BODY.md` (first line `Design review: approve f122a1cb5...`). Read both before writing anything. Items carried to this group in either review: T1a (C1, local mermaid.parse via `npm ci` in tools/site at the pinned version, result in the body), T2, T3 (incl. N3: the sequenceDiagram declares its participants), B1 (incl. N1: read the roster only when at least one marker is present, plus a null-control case with no markers and no roster file), O2 (C7), and N2 (list build_docs.mjs once in Hot files). The note's file list and Hot files apply; the PR body lists every file beyond the roster's files.
Deliverable: docs/architecture.md and the developer onboarding (dev/README.md, the README.md pointer, the `dev` category in tests/layout.json) describing the PROTECTED FINAL SHAPE AT PROGRAMME END: CI shape, orchestration machinery, one handoff's path, architecture. Use mermaid figures in the tree's visual language, markers by the approved grammar for anything not yet on main, the doc_claims checker predicates (a)-(e) as the note specifies with red fixtures and null controls, and the closure re-recorded with `--single` (state the growth).
ALSO in this PR, per the owner (tvofi, 2026-10-22, verbatim): "For the docs PRs, I want a buymeacoffee button added to the top of the repo README and at the bottom of the web page, leading to buymeacoffee.com/rpgshcwb2tp".
- Link https://buymeacoffee.com/rpgshcwb2tp from three places: the top of README.md; docs/index.html's own hand-written <footer> (the landing page, which build_docs.mjs does not render); and the shared footer that tools/site/build_docs.mjs renders on every markdown page.
- Draw the button from in-tree SVG/CSS in the docs.css tokens, legible in light and dark. doc_claims' site rules allow an <a href> to another origin. They refuse an external img, script, stylesheet or CSS url(), so use no hotlinked badge.
- docs/index.html is in this group's reach for this change only. Update tests/doc_claims.py's site arms that read either footer.
- Add a test that pins the link in all three places, with a red case: the button removed from one place.
- These carries are landing on the roster via PR #2603.
Required (fixer.md): failing test first; mutation proof for each new checker predicate and the button test; null control for every quantified claim; architecture score before and after; ratchet budgets — policy_lint --budgets and structure.py must pass, and any raise follows CLAUDE.md rule 2 (stop and report rather than push a raise). Never touch VERSION, the manifest version or RELEASE_NOTES.md heading. Time box 2.5 h. The PR body follows .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, cites the design SHA and both design verdicts, and names this as the docs delivery the owner asked to stamp right after merge.
